alkylation_reagent.evidence: The reduced protein lysate was alkylated using iodoacetamide and incubated for 10 minutes in dark at room temperature.

cleavage_agent.evidence: Protein digestion was carried using TPCK treated trypsin (1:20) at 37°C for 12-16 hours.

enrichment_method.evidence: All the fractions were lyophilized and then subjected to TiO2-based phosphopeptides enrichment.

fractionation_method.evidence: Further the labelled and digested peptides were subjected to bRPLC fractionation.

instrument.evidence: LC-MS/MS analysis of enriched fractions of phosphopeptides was carried using an LTQ-Orbitrap Velos mass spectrometer.

labeling.evidence: we carried out proteomic and phosphoproteomic analysis of HNSCC cell lines using a combination of tandem mass tag (TMT) labeling approach and titanium dioxide-based enrichment.
